en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large two‑storey school building with dormer windows and a central entrance. A long line of schoolchildren and a few adults stand in front of the building behind a fence. Leafless trees and a stone wall appear in the foreground, and a timber‑framed house is visible on the right. The caption at the top is printed in red German text, and there is a vertical publisher's line along the left edge.
